question:
**Directions: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

ENTHRALL
solution:
The correct answer is 'enchant.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word 'Enthrall' means **to fill someone with overwhelming emotion as wonder or delight**. (मंत्रमुग्‍ध कर देना, मोहित करना)

 
 
• Example: *During intervals, the locals **enthrall** the audiences with traditional and cultural performances*.
 
 
 
• ​Let's see the meaning of the given options:-
 
 
• 'Eject' means **to push or send somebody or something out of a place usually with force**. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को प्रायः ज़बरदस्‍ती निकाल बाहर करना)
 
 
• Example: *The pilot managed to **eject** from the jet without sustaining injuries*.
 
 
 
• 'Enchant' means **to fill someone with great delight; charm**. (मंत्रमुग्‍ध कर देना, प्रसन्न करना)
 
 
• Example: *She has endless stories that **enchant **and inform the kids*.
 
 
 
• 'Repel' means **to make somebody feel disgusted**. (वितृष्‍ण या घृणा पैदा कर देना)
 
 
• Example: *I was **repelled** by the smell*.
 
 
 
• 'Incite' means **to encourage somebody to do something by making him or her very angry or excited**. (भड़काना, उकसाना)
 
 
• Example: *She doesn't want to **incite** any kind of violence*.

 
 
 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The synonyms of the word 'Enthrall' are "**enchant, fascinate, mesmerize**".
 
• The antonyms of the word 'Enthrall' are "**bore, tire, weary**".
